title: Add Pathfinder source-fidelity coverage and bounded audit tests
description:
Add Pathfinder generated-pack verification for deterministic regeneration, source/license/
provenance fidelity, schema validity, independently enumerable structural source populations,
and bounded audit diagnostics. Count/category baselines are drift diagnostics unless the
approved source independently establishes membership. Discovery and deterministic-capability
coverage remain separate from source fidelity.
acceptance_criteria:
- Deterministic regeneration and schema/source/license/provenance checks cover generated records.
- Exhaustive coverage assertions identify an independently source-derived structural denominator.
- Count/baseline checks are labeled as drift diagnostics unless they have source-side membership authority.
- Audit output distinguishes source fidelity, discovery support, selected capability support, and unresolved scope.
- Missing/unrecognized data never becomes evidence that the source lacks a mechanic.
notes:
